metrics.neither_incoming_nor_outgoing_project_ed: isolated_in_project_graph=true; no incoming and no outgoing direct project pair
metrics.used_by_at_least_one_different_layer: used_by_different_layer=true; at least one direct project consumer has a different path-derived layer
metrics.used_by_at_least_one_different_module: used_by_different_module=true; at least one direct project consumer has a different owner module
metrics.used_by_multiple_consumer_domains: used_by_multiple_domains=true; direct project consumers occupy at least two audit-classified domains
metrics.used_by_multiple_consumer_modules: used_by_multiple_modules=true; direct project consumers occupy at least two owner modules

universes.all_project_environment: all rows; owner module is NumStability or NumStability.*
universes.confirmed_source_written_public: is_public=true and authorship_class=confirmed_source_written; the latter requires nonreserved name, direct Lean selection range, and exact selected source token matching the terminal name or namespace-qualified suffix
